description: Either NAND or NOR, with the falsity constant, represents every finite truth function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.single_gate_complete
  (k : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.GateKind) (n : ℕ)
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.TruthFunction n) :
  ∃ A,
    ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation (Fin n)),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v A = f v
